journeyStages.outcome: An eligible person can find an accurate explanation of Mythical Void.
currentEvidence: Canonical public pages, crawl files and linked site, studio and game identity are live.
IndexNow accepted the changed-page notices, but the latest four-query sample found no official Mythical Void result and a signed-in read-only check found no Mythical Void Search Console property.

journeyStages.outcome: Players and guardians accurately understand the game, access model, and trust boundaries.
currentEvidence: The owned site explains the game, free access, early-access state, creature language, family boundaries and NASA source boundary.
journeyStages.notYetProven: No unfamiliar adult or guardian comprehension session has been completed.

journeyStages.outcome: A person who chooses to play reaches a usable game load.
currentEvidence: An isolated production check reached the age choice, one Start action and the first egg on desktop and phone.
A real click or tap began hatching and the progress message stayed centred.
journeyStages.notYetProven: This is a controlled production check, not evidence that an unfamiliar person can begin without help.

journeyStages.outcome: A play attempt reaches the first meaningful hatch-and-bond moment.
currentEvidence: The production path is verified through hatching started on desktop and phone.
journeyStages.notYetProven: A completed hatch, recognisable creature reveal and first bond have not passed a fresh human play check.

journeyStages.outcome: The creature, restoration, and choice systems create demonstrated value.
currentEvidence: The running build and verified source support creature variation, six realms, restoration and Project Beacon story systems.
journeyStages.notYetProven: There is no accepted customer evidence that these systems are understood, enjoyable or valuable.

journeyStages.outcome: People voluntarily return because the experience remains valuable.
currentEvidence: A returning route exists, but the current desktop and phone presentation failed the live human-facing visual review.
journeyStages.notYetProven: No voluntary return, retention or returning-player satisfaction is measured.

journeyStages.outcome: Adults and guardians voluntarily share authentic proof or participate in a safe feedback loop.
currentEvidence: Clean owned sharing routes and the Hatch Challenge are live without contact collection or tracking parameters.
journeyStages.notYetProven: No voluntary share, recommendation or advocacy outcome is measured.

experiments.title: Owned discovery visibility
experiments.decisionServed: Whether search engines discover and surface Mythical Void's canonical owned pages after the technical foundation is live.
experiments.hypothesis: Clear canonical pages, crawl files and one verified sitemap submission will make search discovery observable without creating duplicate pages or paid traffic.
experiments.audience: Public web and search infrastructure; no recruited participant cohort
experiments.intervention: Keep the canonical pages technically crawlable, connect Search Console through Kevin's existing Google account, submit the sitemap once and inspect the homepage and Playable Now page.
experiments.comparison: The 27 August four-query sample observed no Mythical Void result while authenticated Google index evidence remained unavailable.
experiments.primaryMeasure: Authenticated indexed-page evidence and search impressions, reported without treating rank or impressions as playership.
experiments.minimumUsefulEvidence: One Search Console inspection of the homepage and Playable Now page, followed by bounded seven-day and fourteen-day checks.
experiments.owner: Kevin / Game Development release owner unassigned

experiments.title: Creature-led positioning comprehension
experiments.decisionServed: Whether initial communications should lead with the creature relationship rather than features or story alone.
experiments.hypothesis: Creature-led positioning will produce clearer comprehension and stronger qualified play intent among adults than feature-led or story-led variants.
experiments.audience: Consenting adults, including parents/guardians and adult creature/narrative-game players
experiments.intervention: Moderated comparison of three accurately bounded message concepts.
experiments.comparison: Creature-led, feature-led, and story-led concepts presented in balanced order.
experiments.primaryMeasure: Accurate unaided comprehension plus qualified stated play intent, reported directionally rather than as market prevalence.
experiments.minimumUsefulEvidence: Ten completed adult sessions with source, order, contradictions, and facilitator notes reviewed under Round 001A.

experiments.title: Guardian trust comprehension
experiments.decisionServed: Whether an adult guardian can accurately understand Mythical's cost, access, local-save, safety, AI, and contact boundaries.
experiments.hypothesis: Adult guardians can find and accurately explain the current trust model without receiving additional verbal guidance.
experiments.intervention: Moderated find-and-explain tasks using the current site and explicit uncertainty coding.
experiments.comparison: Expected answers derived only from current usable or qualified claims and verified public behavior.
experiments.primaryMeasure: Task completion and accurate recall, with every material misconception recorded qualitatively.
experiments.minimumUsefulEvidence: Five adult guardian sessions before broadening, with all trust-critical misconceptions reviewed regardless of frequency.
guardrails: no sensitive data in shared notes
safeguarding issues route to a named human before live intake

experiments.title: Identifier-free aggregate activation counters
experiments.decisionServed: Whether M1 counters can provide directionally useful attempt-level activation evidence without persistent player identity.
experiments.hypothesis: Allowlisted identifier-free counters can reconcile synthetic attempts and support coarse activation decisions without joining events into player profiles.
experiments.audience: Synthetic validation only until privacy, product, network, logging, ownership, and Kevin gates are complete
experiments.intervention: Validate and later, only if approved, pilot the M1 event contract.
experiments.comparison: Known synthetic event totals and manually calculated aggregate ratios.
experiments.primaryMeasure: Aggregate reconciliation accuracy and decision usefulness using events/attempts language.
experiments.minimumUsefulEvidence: A bounded synthetic reconciliation plus reviewed proof of field rejection, logging separation, small-cell rules, kill switch, and no identifiers.
guardrails: DPIA and kill switch before activation
